summary: Frontend-only test of it60 futuriste style bundle (5 volets + fix Layout critique). All 6 acceptance criteria passed. TELEMETRIE readout at bas-gauche (9px, rgba(124,147,168,0.8), JetBrains Mono, pointer-events:none) shows '—' offmap, 'HORS SECTEUR · X.... · Y.... · Z ...' between membranes, and sector name uppercase (e.g. 'CLIENT') over a domain membrane. FLORE opens without collapsing the map: with panel open [data-testid=system-map] measured 1480x1032 (height preserved, width reduced ~440px — the Google Maps paradigm works). FlorePanel carries classes hud-gauche + hud-violet, hud-reflexion pulse observed during POST /api/aurora/demander, curseur-teletype detected in DOM during typing of last response. Déploiement: 48 .node-deploiement nodes at mount, all 48 react-flow nodes visible after animation; return from /travaux redeploys correctly. HUD: notif-panel carries 'hud' class. Glow-hover: 6/6 travail-row-*, 41/41 jumeau-row-*, 7/7 initiative-* (2 on Radar + 5 on À traiter). Régression: 0 console errors on /atlas /travaux /actualites /jumeaux; 1366px no overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==1366); zoom-niveau shows 'Niveau 2 · Domaine'.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx correctly implements flex-row root with FlorePanel as lateral column — the previous flex-col regression that collapsed map height is fixed and verified (1032px height retained with Flore open at 1920x1080).
CarteInitiative renders only when vue!='brief' on Actualites; glow-hover class correctly applied on all rendered cards.
TELEMETRIE updates via DOM manipulation (no React re-render), as designed — verified through inner_text reads at multiple coordinates.
context_for_next_testing_agent: It60 style futuriste (télémétrie, HUD biseauté, déploiement cascade, glow-hover, télétype Flore) validated 100%. Verified map dimensions with Flore open: 1480x1032 at 1920x1080 viewport — no height collapse. curseur-teletype only present during typing of last Flore response; observed via MutationObserver polling (visible ~200ms after Enter). initiative-* cards render on Actualites only when vue != 'brief' (click vue-a_traiter or vue-radar first). node-deploiement is applied to all 48 nodes at mount and re-applied on remount when navigating back to /atlas — as intended.
